summary: Frontend auth testing completed. Admin login flow works correctly with Supabase auth. 4/6 tests passed. Found 2 issues: (1) ProtectedRoute infinite loading when admin accesses seller/buyer dashboards, (2) Poor error message for invalid credentials.

ui_bugs.issue: Infinite loading spinner when admin user navigates to /dashboard/seller or /dashboard/buyer. Should redirect to home page but gets stuck on loading state.
ui_bugs.root_cause: The isChecking state with 100ms timeout in ProtectedRoute.js may be causing race condition with auth state. The redirect to '/' is not executing properly.

integration_issues.issue: Error message shows 'Failed to execute json on Response: body stream already read' instead of user-friendly message like 'Invalid email or password'

action_items: Fix ProtectedRoute.js to properly redirect admin users when accessing seller/buyer dashboards - currently shows infinite loading spinner instead of redirecting to home
Improve error handling in auth.js login function to show user-friendly error messages for invalid credentials
critical_code_review_comments: ProtectedRoute.js: The isChecking state with setTimeout(100ms) may cause race conditions. Consider using useEffect dependency on user.role instead.
auth.js: The Supabase error message is passed directly to toast without sanitization. Should catch and transform error messages for better UX.

tests_executed.TEST_1_Admin_Login: PASSED - Admin login with support@arabshopping.org redirects to /dashboard/admin, displays 'Welcome back, Admin'
tests_executed.TEST_2_Invalid_Credentials: PARTIAL - Shows error toast but message is technical ('body stream already read') instead of user-friendly
tests_executed.TEST_3_Unauthenticated_Redirect: PASSED - Unauthenticated user accessing /dashboard/admin redirects to /login
tests_executed.TEST_4_Admin_Role_Authorization: FAILED - Admin accessing /dashboard/seller shows infinite loading spinner instead of redirecting to home
tests_executed.TEST_5_Admin_Dashboard_Welcome: PASSED - Dashboard shows 'Welcome back, Admin' with user name from public.users table
tests_executed.TEST_6_Logout: PASSED - Logout clears session and redirects to /login

context_for_next_testing_agent: Supabase auth refactor is working for core login/logout flows. The ProtectedRoute has a bug where it shows infinite loading instead of redirecting when user role doesn't match allowed roles. Admin dashboard fully functional. Error messages for invalid credentials need improvement.
